code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD alert details
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::alert_details
       Returns or sets alert details.

SYNOPSIS
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_details (VALUE)?

DESCRIPTION
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_details ;
	   Returns alert details.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_details VALUE ;
	   Sets alert details.

RETURN VALUE
       ANTIFRAUD::alert_details ;
	   Returns alert details.

       ANTIFRAUD::alert_details VALUE ;
	   No return value (sets alert details).

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_ALERT

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "original Alert details: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_details]."
	    ANTIFRAUD::alert_details new_value
	    log local0. "new Alert details: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_details]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
